items.question: How do I book a transfer or tour?
items.answer: You can book directly through our website or contact us on WhatsApp for a personalised quote. Once we confirm availability, you'll receive a booking confirmation by email.

items.question: How far in advance should I book?
items.answer: We recommend booking at least 48 hours in advance for standard transfers and 4+ days for Sprinter/group bookings. Same-day requests can be handled via WhatsApp subject to availability.

items.question: Can I modify my booking after confirmation?
items.answer: Yes — modifications are welcome subject to availability. Contact us as early as possible and we'll do our best to accommodate changes at no extra charge.

items.question: What payment methods do you accept?
items.answer: We accept major credit/debit cards, bank transfers, and PayPal. Cash payment on the day is also available for certain services — confirm at time of booking.

items.question: Are your prices fixed or can they change?
items.answer: All quoted prices are fixed and inclusive of VAT. There are no hidden fees — tolls, parking, and waiting time within the included grace period are all covered.

items.question: How does PayPal payment work?
items.answer: After booking confirmation, we'll send a PayPal payment request to your email. You can pay with your PayPal balance or any linked card — no PayPal account required.

items.question: What is your cancellation policy?
items.answer: Cancellations more than 48 hours before your Sedan/Van transfer receive a full refund. Under 48 hours, 50% is charged; under 24 hours, 100% is charged. Sprinter bookings have extended windows — see our Booking Policies page for full details.

items.question: How much waiting time is included?
items.answer: Airport pickups include 60 minutes of complimentary waiting time after the flight lands. All other pickups include 15 minutes. Additional waiting time is billed at an hourly rate.

items.question: Are your vehicles electric?
items.answer: Our fleet includes hybrid and electric Mercedes-Benz models. If you have a preference, let us know at the time of booking and we'll do our best to accommodate.

items.question: Do your drivers speak English?
items.answer: Yes — all our chauffeurs are fluent in English and Portuguese. Some also speak French and Spanish. Language preference can be noted at the time of booking.

items.question: What is included in the tour price?
items.answer: All tours include the chauffeur, vehicle, fuel, tolls, and any planned stops. Entrance fees to attractions and meals are not included unless explicitly stated in your quote.

items.question: Do you have vehicles for longer routes?
items.answer: Absolutely. We serve routes across Portugal and into Spain. Our Sprinter is ideal for groups or extended itineraries. Contact us for a custom quote.

home.whyChooseTitle: Why Choose Off We Go Portugal
home.whyChooseBody: Off We Go Portugal is a premium chauffeur service, offering luxury private transportation across Lisbon, Porto, and the Algarve. With a high-end Mercedes-Benz fleet, multilingual professional drivers, and 24/7 availability, we deliver an exceptional travel experience for discerning travellers, business executives, and families.
home.airportTransfersBody: We provide seamless airport transfers at Lisbon (LIS), Porto (OPO) and Faro (FAO) airports. Every transfer includes complimentary flight monitoring, 60 minutes of free waiting time, meet & greet service and fixed prices with no hidden fees. Whether you need a private driver from the airport to your hotel or a long-distance transfer to the Algarve, our chauffeur service ensures a stress-free arrival.
home.privateToursBody: Discover Portugal with a private chauffeur. Our curated tours include Sintra's fairy-tale palaces, the Douro Valley wine region, the sacred sanctuary of Fatima and the stunning Algarve coastline. Every tour is fully customisable — choose your itinerary, pace and stops. Perfect for couples, families and small groups seeking an authentic Portuguese experience.
home.sustainableFleetBody: Our fleet features the latest Mercedes-Benz electric vehicles — EQS, EQE and EQV — alongside executive diesel options including S-Class, E-Class and V-Class. As a sustainable chauffeur service, we prioritise zero-emission transport without compromising on luxury, comfort or performance. Ideal for corporate clients with ESG requirements.
home.areasWeServeBody: Our luxury chauffeur service covers all major destinations in Portugal: Lisbon and Greater Lisbon (Cascais, Sintra, Estoril), Porto and Northern Portugal (Douro Valley, Braga, Guimarães), the Algarve (Faro, Albufeira, Vilamoura, Lagos, Tavira), and Central Portugal (Coimbra, Évora, Óbidos, Nazaré). We also offer cross-border transfers to Spain.
